certificates.case_checks: From raw gens, line primitives, storage, thermal blocks and new dispatch, independent dimensional 168h physics plus mapped sparse affine rows. Every core candidate obeys its enforced strength family; inactive diagnostic failure or unavailable inverse is not a rejection.
certificates.M0_scope: Only for SPD, symmetric Z B, p within the approved tiny negativity diagnostic tolerance and entrywise inverse nonnegative to arithmetic tolerance. Empty margin = domain unqualified. Failed_hours excludes undefined hours. Slack=1-max(B^-1 p).
certificates.source: AC retained physical regions=37, eliminated=0; 7 independent passive islands. Source status, native voltage and MVA stamps reconstructed independently; positive GFM credit once. Actual wind/PV injected generation distinct from native online and availability-weighted prospective exposure.
certificates.residuals: Common dump comparator shares coefficient source only across aligned data/model families; typed G3-specific row/column metadata excluded. Original physical independent reconstruction for each family is primary. Each physical maximum includes absolute, unit threshold and normalized ratio. Solver bounds are numerical, not outward-rounded rigorous certificates.
certificates.event_policy: Positive simultaneous SU and SD is allowed. Reducing both by their minimum preserves transition difference, loosens both event bounds and minimum-time inequalities; no changes to original retained incumbents or their reported UB. SD=0.2 SU is the study assumption.
